solver: <YOUR_SOLVER, e.g. cvc5 - namespaces the build queue, S3/R2 state, and fuzzing schedule; also the destination directory name every workflow clones your upstream source into>

coverage.setup_command: <shell command to configure/prepare the build before tests can be listed, e.g. ./configure.sh>
coverage.list_tests_command: <shell command whose stdout is one test name per line, run from your repo root>
coverage.run_test_command: <shell command containing a literal {test} placeholder that runs one test; exit 0 = passed>

fuzzer.tests_root: <path to your seed test corpus, relative to your repo root>
fuzzer.list_tests_command: <shell command whose stdout is one seed-test path per line, relative to tests_root>
fuzzer.solver_cli: <extra CLI flags always passed when fuzzing/triage invoke this solver's own binary, e.g. '--check-models --check-proofs --strings-exp -q'; empty string if none>
fuzzer.oracle_solver: <name of the reference solver to diff against, e.g. z3>

oracle_fetch_fallback.package: <pip package for the reference solver, e.g. z3-solver>
